literal_meaning: Divine affair or act of God
figurative_meaning_en: A grand affair; great pomp and show
example_sentences_in_bangla: উৎসবে ইলাহী কাণ্ডের মতো আয়োজন হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There's a grand spectacle going on at the wedding house.
